B1.name: Light Sword
B1.description: {{nickname}} conjures a compressed light sword and does melee [Light] attacks.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Slash in several quick arcs in front, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Slash in a line ahead, dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack. Inflict [Knockback] on hit opponents.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slam into the ground, dealing AoE damage in a 1-meter radius equal to % of attack.

additional.text: {{effect:knockback}}

B2.name: Light Discharge
B2.description: {{nickname}} discharges light, bending it around {{object}} in myriad ways, dealing [Light] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Launches a beam of light, dealing damage equal to % of health. Applies [Blind] to hit opponents.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Slashes in two arcs in separate directions, dealing % of health as damage.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Charges up a ball of light and thrusts it at opponents, dealing % of health as damage and inflicting [Burn]. If the opponent already has the debuff when attacked, deal an immediate instance of [Burn], but with the self’s crit stats added.

additional.text: {{effect:blind}}
{{effect:burn}}

S1.name: Light Searching Spheres
S1.description: {{nickname}} shoots 10 light orbs that follow enemies and implode on contact, dealing % of {{possessive}} attack as [Light] AoE ranged damage in a 1-meter radius and applying [Blind]. Projectiles will hone in on the closest opponents.

additional.text: Hold the skill to launch projectiles in the aimed direction, one at a time.

If projectiles don’t hit targets, they return, and the active character gains  MP back for each sphere, at the cost of 3% of {{nickname}}’s [Shield], with each percentage based on max health. If {{nickname}} is off-field, {{subject}} also gains % of the MP.
{{effect:blind}}
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Mana Cost: 120 MP
Hold Mana Cost: 15 MP

S2.name: Mythical Healing
S2.description: {{nickname}} raises {{possessive}} hand and creates a circle of magic that lasts for 12 seconds and heals all allies for % of {{possessive}} max health per second.

additional.text: Applies a [Shield] to all allies equal to % of max health a single time. For {{nickname}}, {{subject}} instead gains [Shield] equal to % of {{possessive}} health every second while the field is active. This can also trigger when {{subject}} is off-field.
Deals % of attack as [Light] damage to all opponents within the circle per second. Reduce their movement speed by -25%. Each successful hit will fill self and allies’ energy gauge by +%.
Hold skill to decrease the field’s size, increase its damage, and extend duration.
{{effect:shield}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Base Mana Cost: 210 MP
> Hold Mana Cost Level 1: 200 MP
-25% size, +25% damage, +5 seconds
> Hold Mana Cost Level 2: 260 MP
-50% size, +50% damage, +10 seconds
> Hold Mana Cost Level 3 (Max): 315 MP
-80% size, +100% damage, +20 seconds

S3.name: Light Compression
S3.description: Condensing light around {{object}} into any object, {{nickname}} gains newfound versatility. Hold down the skill button to cycle through weapons and letting go will select the specific weapon as the new active Basic Skill.

additional.text: Basic Skill: Compressed Light Sword: A denser weapon, increases Basic Skill damage by +%, keeping original Basic Skill stages. Every other hit will be an empowered attack.
Basic Skill: Compressed Barrier: Creates a barrier of light in front, with health equal to % of stat used by the Basic Skill (Cooldown: 15 seconds).

Basic Skill: Compressed Light Bow: Creates a ranged damaging weapon; +% more attack when hitting more than 10 meters, but +50% damage taken. Uses preset Basic Skill Stage 1 damage multiplier per projectile. Hold Basic Skill to charge up a powerful 3-arrow attack.

Basic Skill: Lighted Trebuchet: Summons a trebuchet on spot that hurls projectiles on opponents, dealing +% increased damage as ranged AoE. Uses preset Basic Skill Stage 1 damage multiplier. Basic Skill will activate trebuchet.
<u>Basic Skill: Default</u>: Resets and changes to preset Basic Skill.
Cooldown: 1.5 seconds
Mana Cost: 30 MP

U1.name: Limitless Light Beam
U1.description: {{nickname}}’s body begins to glow with immense light. {{Subject}} shoots a beam of laser that can be directed towards opponents for a short duration dealing % of attack as [Light] ranged damage per second. The rate increases to per half-second when hitting a single target.

additional.text: Hit opponents receive the [Blind] effect. Upon activation, allies and self receive the buff [Enlightened].
{{effect:blind}}
{{effect:enlightened}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

U2.name: Mystical Legends, Unite!
U2.description: When the dire time comes, calls upon the aid of all Mystical Legends allies to arrive at the forefront of the battle for a prolonged duration.

additional.text: Each ally retains their stats and equipment if owned, otherwise won’t be called. They start with % of their base stats. When summoned, their Special Skills are on their respective cooldowns instead of immediately being usable.

Besides {{nickname}} {{reflexive}}, each Mystical Legends ally that joins will lock the use of a team member (in order of their party placement), but their Star Level passives and Technical Skill passives still function. At max 3 will be locked. There is no limit to the number of summoned allies that join.
Mystical Legends:
{{nickname}} (self)
{{nickname:c2}}
{{nickname:c3}}
{{nickname:c5}}
{{nickname:c10}}
{{nickname:c15}}
{{nickname:c16}}
Skill can be used only once per battle. While out of combat, the skill can be used for free and the summoned allies will leave after a short duration.
As long as this skill is equipped, the energy gauge for the team increases by half its usual speed.
Energy Gauge: 100% of the team's energy gauge.

T1.name: Transformation
T1.description: Ability: {{nickname}} lets magic pour out and changes parts of {{possessive}} body into water, gaining an aquatic state. By doing so, {{possessive}} skills will become [Water] elemental attacks until this Technical Skill is used again.

additional.text: While in this state, {{subject}} gains [Shield] +50% more effectively and consumes a single percentage per second, increasing {{possessive}} and allies’ damage reduction by +35% until depletion. This functions even while off-field.

Speed is enhanced by +25%. Flight Mode will turn {{nickname}} into a stream of water instead called Aqua Mode; collision with opponents in this mode will deal 0.5% of health multiplied by each percentage of healing rate as [Water] damage every 0.3 seconds. A trail of water is made behind {{object}}.

Resonance: Other characters that are Water Spirit or Naiad species can utilize this ability, including Aqua Mode. If the character has an element affinity other than [Water], then their element is not overridden by this skill.

T2.name: Enlightened Mode
T2.description: {{nickname}} enters enlightened mode after using an Ultimate Skill, where {{subject}} gains a special light meter which accumulates specific element points, lasting for 25 seconds and resetting whenever the Ultimate Skill is used again. Each new element aura applied to opponents will fill the light meter by 1, up to a max of 20, if the light meter is active.

additional.text: When a [Light] element attack from an ally or self hits an opponent with an elemental aura (applied by a contributor, either self or ally), the attack will become a special discharge called [True Light Element]. This occurs only once per every 2 points gained.

[True Light Element]: A special element attack that deals additional damage based on the aura element, equal to 5% of the inflictor’s health in a small AoE. The attack can crit based on the crit stats of the inflictor.
The following are the immediate obtainable effects gained for inflictor and contributor based on the type of element aura in the discharge, lasting the duration of light meter:
> [Fire]: Damage of skills increases by +10% for 5 seconds. Gain an additional +5% damage increase for each point in the light meter.
> [Wind]: Attack speed of Basic Skills increases by +3% per point on any light meter. The AoE of attacks, even on single target ones, increases by +50% while the meter is active.
> [Earth]: Defense increases by +2% per point on any light meter. Debuffs applied on opponents have their duration increased by +0.5 seconds per point on any light meter.
> [Water]: Health and defense increases by +25% for 5 seconds. Gain the effect [Embrace of the Goddess].
{{effect:embrace-goddess}}

Additional instances of the same special attack can occur, +1 more for every 4 points in any light meter, up to max +5 instances. Simultaneous effects can be activated but require different instances with their respective auras.
The damage of the special element attack increases by +10% for each level of basic skill of inflictor.
Resonance: If {{nickname}} is not in the team, the first [Light] affinity character in the team can activate the light meter with their Ultimate Skill.

T3.name: Goddess' Spirit Release
T3.description: <u>Ability</u>: Consume 50% of {{nickname}}'s health to summon the goddess Lynnhera, acting as an ally to aid {{object}} and the team. When you gain this skill, Lynnhera becomes a character who can use equipment and artifacts, but only the passives and set effects activate initially. She is summoned with 20% of her max health and shares the same stats as {{nickname}}. Like any party character, she can benefit from buffs and teamwide status effects.

additional.text: The damage of Lynnhera’s skills increases by +10% for each level of {{nickname}}’s equipped Basic Skill. She utilizes the following skills:

<u>Basic Skill: Spell Pulse</u> - Lynnhera shoots a rainbow vibrating bullet that deals 120% of attack as damage and inflicts a random debuff. Can continuously charge the shot for increased scaling: +1% attack increase in the first second, then doubling every second afterward, but must remain idle.

Special Skill - Bridge of Fortitude - Lynnhera summons a bridge, gaining 1.2% of her health multiplied by each percentage of healing rate, that only she and allies can stand on, elevating them and shielding them from damage until it is destroyed. When standing on the bridge, she and her allies gain +25% mana regen.
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Mana Cost: 35 seconds
<u>Special Skill: Black Hole</u> - Lynnhera forms a black vacuum, lasting 5 seconds, that sucks opponents together, dealing continuous damage equal to 200% of attack per second.
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 25 seconds

Lynnhera’s damage will always be an elemental advantage over her opponents (indicated in pink numbers). An additional ability will allow {{nickname}} and her to switch as the active user, which can be controlled. In so doing, the other will remain on the field as an ally.

Using this skill again while the goddess is active will sacrifice her for {{nickname}} to gain the buff [The Magni Mage]. If she is defeated in the current battle, she will grant the buff permanently to {{nickname}} and cannot be re-summoned. If {{nickname}} is defeated, she will disappear as well.

Auxiliary Passive: The Goddess’ Meter persists even when Lynnhera is not present. This meter lasts until all MP equal to {{nickname}}’s max is spent. Every 300 MP spent on the meter will send a holy shockwave in an AoE, inflicting a [Light] aura and canceling the opponent's Special Skill cast. Every 200 MP spent unlocks +5% of her equipped equipment and artifact stats and increases her and {{nickname}}’s shared stats.
{{effect:magni-mage}}
Energy Gauge: 100%
Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: Every third melee hit will grant all allies and self 1 instance of [Goddess’ Blessing]. It can also grant a stack passively once every 3 seconds when off-field. At five stacks, the effect activates.

additional.text: Upon dashing, pressing any Special Skill will allow {{nickname}} to enter Flight Mode, gradually losing stamina, which will greatly enhance {{possessive}} speed by +25%, height and damage reduction by +50%, and ranged damage by +10%, until stamina is empty or the Dash Skill is used again. Remaining idle does not consume stamina.
Guiding Light: At night or in a dark environment, {{nickname}} emits a glow around {{object}} to light the surroundings. {{Subject}} also reveals hidden treasures.
<u>Alter Exclusive Rule</u>: {{nickname:c1b}}’s Star Levels (except base) are deactivated while as {{nickname}}.
{{effect:goddess-blessing}}
Gain [Shield] equal to 0.5% of total health, multiplied by each percentage of healing rate, for self and allies when using any Special Skill.
{{effect:shield}}
When attacking, after inflicting [Blind] on any opponent, gain 1 stack of [Angel's Touch] up to a max of 25 for self and all allies.
{{effect:angel-touch}}
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

When an ally drops below 20% health, swap health points with that ally and gain the effect [Rapid Recovery]. This ability can be triggered only when {{nickname}}’s health is greater than the ally’s (Cooldown: 120 seconds).
{{effect:rapid-recovery}}
After using Stage 3 of the Basic Skill, convert the next Basic Skill attack into Basic Skill: Lotus Wildflare Beam. After use, it reverts to the normal Basic Skill.
10% of max health will also be added as additional basic damage numbers to all of Avery’s skills that inflict damage (Basic, Special, Ultimate, and Technical, including summons).

Basic Skill: Lost Lotus Light Beam - {{nickname}} summons a concentration of light that blasts in a flower-like arch in front of {{object}}, blowing opponents away with [Knockback], dealing 230% of attack as damage, applying [Blind], and gaining five stacks of [Goddess' Blessing] for self and allies. Special Skill cooldowns for self are reduced by 3 seconds, and 50 MP is instantly restored for self and allies. Damage scales up by +10% for each level of the equipped Basic Skill.

B1.name: Ice Manipulation
B1.description: {{nickname}} unleashes a valley of ice that encircles and traps opponents, dealing [Water] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Hurls ice chunks at nearby opponents, dealing small AoE damage equal to % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Summons spikes of ice to emerge from the ground around opponents, dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack and remaining on-field for a short time. Inflicts the [Freeze] debuff on hit opponents.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Explodes the ice spikes, dealing % of attack as AoE empowered damage.

additional.text: {{effect:freeze}}

S1.name: Ice Pillars
S1.description: {{nickname}} creates a circle of four pillars of ice around {{object}} that shoot from the ground, dealing % of attack as [Water] damage.

additional.text: Holding the skill will summon one pillar at a time that can be aimed towards a specific direction. The skill has four charges and all are consumed to summon remaining pillars when skill is tapped.

Summoned pillars remain active for 15 seconds and act as destructible barriers. They remain in resonance with each other, dealing % of attack as [Water] damage which is multiplied by the number of pillars present, up to 4.
When destroyed by any character or opponent, they explode for AoE [Water] empowered damage equal to % of attack and inflict [Blind] and [Freeze] on anyone who is not {{nickname}} {{reflexive}}.
{{effect:blind}}
{{effect:freeze}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Mana Cost: 120 MP
Mana Cost per Pillar: 30 MP

S2.name: Arsenal of Ice
S2.description: {{nickname}} will create various objects of ice to aid in {{possessive}} battle. Hold down skill to rotate between a list of items; then letting go will select the specified item.

additional.text: Special Skill: Ice Beam - A directable beam, with a medium range, that does continuous damage equal to % of attack as [Water] damage per half-second for 4 seconds.
Special Skill: Ice Mass - {{nickname}} hurls a single boulder of ice that hits an opponent, dealing % of attack as [Water] empowered damage.

Special Skill: Javelins’ Dance - {{nickname}} summons a ring of (scales by level, rounded up) javelins around {{object}} that {{subject}} hurls to opponents, dealing AoE [Water] damage equal to 160% of attack per javelin. When {{subject}} is off-field, the javelins will be thrusted in 1 second intervals until no javelins are left.
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Mana Cost: 120 MP
Javelin’ Dance Mana Cost: 150 MP

S3.name: Cubic Trinity
S3.description: {{nickname}} summons three cubes that swirl around {{object}}, lasting a brief time, and will implode upon contact with an opponent, dealing 350% of attack as AoE [Water] empowered damage. The cubes can remain even when {{nickname}} is off-field.

additional.text: For each cube imploded, {{subject}} will gain a stack, up to three stacks, of the buff [Ice Prince]. After each cube implodes, they remain for 10 seconds on-field, dealing 180% of attack as AoE [Water] damage per second.
{{effect:ice-prince}}
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 110 MP

U1.name: Limitless Ice Beam
U1.description: {{nickname}} charges up a stronger ice beam, gaining high range, that {{subject}} blasts in two directions from {{possessive}} hands, dealing continuous [Water] damage per half-second equal to 240% of attack for 7 seconds.

additional.text: Hit opponents will gain the [Freeze] debuff and any subsequent hits during this state will increase their damage taken by +100%. The hit opponents will also gain debuff immunity reduction of -30% for the duration of skill.
{{effect:freeze}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

U2.name: Absolute Zero
U2.description: Mustering the very limits of {{possessive}} ice magic, {{nickname}} unleashes a storm of ice particles and erupts a large ice spike from the ground, dealing 870% of attack as [Water] AoE damage.

additional.text: An ice rink will form after the attack that will continuously apply [Freeze] to opponents when they are hit with [Water] element attacks from any source, lasting 16 seconds.
During the effect, all other elements in the party will decrease in effectiveness by -100%. [Water] and [Dark] damage will, however, increase by +70%.
{{effect:freeze}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Ice Travel
T1.description: {{nickname}} will phase through the shadow realm with the creation of two ice portals. This mechanic works by synchronizing two portals, each placed separately by using this skill twice. Portals will remain indefinitely while in a combat session. Use the skill again after placing two portals to reset and remove them.

additional.text: The two portals will allow any character to travel between them rapidly. Upon a successful warp, the character gains the buff [Shadow Miasma]. Standing within the portal after warping will maintain the effect.
If {{nickname}} gains the effect, {{possessive}} Special Skill attacks will also do [Dark] damage during its duration.
{{effect:shadow-miasma}}
Energy Gauge: 8% per portal
Resonance: Other [Dark] affinity characters in team who are Icelorian or Gostlynger can utilize this ability.

Dupes.description: {{nickname}} will gain a [Shield] equal to 350% of {{possessive}} defense whenever {{possessive}} health reaches at or below 50% (Cooldown: 30 seconds). {{Subject}} will also accumulate stacks of [Flash] upon successful Basic Skill attack hits with a cooldown of 1 second.

additional.text: {{Subject}} gains resonance within a party of more than 3 different affinities (dual affinity characters count both). Resonance will improve {{possessive}} and the team’s damage reduction by +20% and each hit from an opponent has a 50% chance to remove a debuff on the active character who is hit.

<u>Ice Fowler</u>: While not in combat, {{nickname}}, when dashing, will create a trail of ice behind {{object}} as {{subject}} surfs on an ice field. After some time, the trail melts to water. This state increases {{possessive}} movement speed by +40% and reduces stamina consumption by -50%. {{Possessive}} movement across water is not reduced.
The secrets of District 1 are revealed when {{subject}} is present. As a genius, puzzles will reveal a hint as the prodigy sees solutions effortlessly.
<u>Alter Exclusive Rule</u>: Ion Mustard (Alter)’s Star Levels (except base) are deactivated while as {{nickname}}.
{{effect:shield}}
{{effect:flash}}
The [Freeze] effect can be stacked for the duration of attacks that add it. For each stack, {{nickname}}’s damage will increase by +5%.
{{effect:freeze}}
The [Flash] effect can be applied to allies also but at half the speed, along with gaining continuous stacks of [Fatigue] on self for every stack gained on self.
The Technical Skill: Ice Travel will apply effect even if {{nickname}} stands within 10 meters of any portal. The range of [Shadow Miasma] will also increase by +100%.
{{effect:fatigue}}
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
{{nickname}} will gain an awakened state upon reaching 30 stacks of [Fatigue] in which {{possessive}} eye reveals a special power, gaining the buff [Icengon].
{{effect:icengon}}

Whenever this character gains [Fatigue], gain 1% of health as mana for self and heal allies for that percentage of health. Deal an additional +5% more damage on opponents for each stack of [Freeze] applied.
The gaining of [Flash] will now be as fast as each Basic Skill stage, therefore increasing the rate of accumulation without a cooldown.
While in the [Icengon] state, Kaden will gain the buff [Black Ice] which lasts for the duration of [Fatigue] present. The [Fatigue] effect will deplete twice as slow.
{{effect:black-ice}}
{{effect:midnight-frost}}

B1.name: Meteor Bash
B1.description: {{nickname}} sends heavy kicks of metal-enhanced moves against opponents, dealing [Earth] damage. The damage dealt becomes [Shield] for self equal to % of its value dealt.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Thrusts several quick fists at the opponent, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Launches spheres of metal towards opponents in a line in a short point range, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slams a metal wall in front, dealing % of defense as empowered damage.

additional.text: {{effect:shield}}

S1.name: Metal Barrier
S1.description: {{nickname}} creates a large destructible metal barrier in front of {{object}} with health and defense equal to % of {{possessive}} own defense stat for its toughness to deflect incoming attacks and endure damage. {{Subject}} then gives [Shield] equal to % of defense to self and allies.

additional.text: If [Invention] is active upon using this skill, instead, give [Shield] equal to an additional % of defense to self and allies and the metal barrier gains twice {{possessive}} defense instead. If an attack hits the barrier, the attacker has an all element resistance reduction of -20%. Clear a stack of [Invention].
{{effect:shield}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Mana Cost: 85 MP

S2.name: Rods of Steel
S2.description: Launches a large beam of steel towards opponents, dealing [Earth] empowered damage equal to % of defense. Hit opponents will gain the effect [Dazed].

additional.text: If [Invention] is active, several more beams (+3 more of them) will be shot out, dealing the same damage. Clear a stack of [Invention].
If Ted’s Ultimate Skill: Metal Mode is active, the shot beams Nate much greater in size, AoE, and +100% damage. Inflicts [Knockback III] on hit and sending them airborne.
{{effect:dazed}}
{{effect:knockback3}}
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Mana Cost: 130 MP

S3.name: Overloaded
S3.description: Stands still for 5 seconds to load and charge a firearm cannon, absorbing the element affinities in the party into charged shells. Once cannon is loaded, it will be a summon with health and defense equal to % of {{nickname}}’s defense stat.

additional.text: While {{nickname}} is on-field, {{subject}} can ride the cannon, gaining +50% damage reduction, and hold this skill to charge up empowered shots. When holding, a stack of [Let’m Cook] is consumed every half-second, up to a max of 6. Up to 3 of these shots can be fired. Releasing skill will trigger the following conditions:
Less than 6 stacks - Shoot a compiled bullet at aimed direction, dealing [Earth] AoE empowered damage equal to % of defense multiplied by the number of each consumed stack.

At 6 stacks - Shoot an overpowering bullet at aimed direction, dealing % of defense as a large AoE super empowered [Earth] element, and the encompassing elements of the team, damage, applying all auras at once. If [Invention] is active, consume a stack and a secondary shell is quickly fired, dealing 120% of the previous’ damage.

When {{nickname}} is off-field, the cannon will aim and periodically shoot mixed-element bullets, dealing % of defense as [Earth] damage. Cannon shoots every 2 seconds. 50% chance of the bullet being infused with one other element of the team. If a Mystical Legends ally is on-field, the interval of attack decreases to 1 second and an element is always infused.
If the skill is used while a summon is present, its health will be restored and no charging is necessary. New shells are also provided.
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Mana Cost: 100 MP per shot

U1.name: Metal Mode
U1.description: {{nickname}} will encase metal armor around {{reflexive}} to gain extra defense and outward fighting power, lasting for 16 seconds.

additional.text: Upon activation, {{nickname}} will gain +100% movement speed and +20% damage reduction.

Model A: Charge forward and deal [Earth] super empowered damage equal to % of defense to any opponent in {{possessive}} path. Any skills used in conjunction with this Ultimate’s effect will deal +% more damage. Basic Skill’s attack speed increases by +30%.

Model B: If off-field, the metal armor will dissipate and form into 2 hovering robotic turret drones that will blast energy pulses towards nearby opponents, dealing % of defense as [Earth] damage per blast.

If two or more stacks of [Invention] are active, instead, gain +50% damage reduction, +150% movement speed, and +50% skill damage for Model A. Summon an extra drone for Model B and the active character gains +30% damage reduction. Clear all stacks of [Invention].
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Ultimate Arsenal
T1.description: Ability: Upon using this skill, various effects will activate upon having varying stacks of [Invention]:

additional.text: 1 stack, gain the effect [Gamer]. 2 stacks, gain the effect [Tinkering]. 3+ stacks, turn into Special Skill: Hoverboard which may be used anytime. Stacks do not get consumed when counting and using this skill.
{{effect:gamer}}
{{effect:tinkering}}

Special Skill: Hoverboard - {{nickname}} jumps onto a hoverboard, hovers in the air for a moment with short invulnerability, and crashes {{possessive}} way through {{possessive}} opponents, dealing 325% of attack and 275% of defense as [Fire] and [Earth] AoE damage. The damage scales by +10% for each level of the equipped Basic Skill.
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Resonance: No additional effects. Exclusive to {{nickname}}.

Dupes.description: For every opponent hit, {{nickname}} will gain a stack of [Let'm Cook] which lasts indefinitely. {{Subject}} inflicts [Attack Down I] on nearby opponents every 5 stacks gained.

additional.text: {{effect:letm-cook}}
{{effect:invention}}
{{effect:attack-down1}}
Each stack of [Let'm Cook] will increase defense by +0.25% permanently for the battle and gained [Shield] on self will also apply to allies as well.
{{nickname}}’s Technical Skill effects will also be applied to the party for the same duration.

Gain a [Super Shield] for self equal to 150% of defense after using any Special Skills, the effect is shared amongst the party. Whenever the Dash Skill is used, gain a stack of [Let'm Cook] (Cooldown: 2 seconds).
The inflicted debuff [Attack Down I] is enhanced to [Attack Down III] and an additional debuff [Crit Down II] is inflicted.
{{effect:super-shield}}
{{effect:attack-down3}}
{{effect:crit-down2}}
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

Charge energy gauge by +10% per stack of [Invention] gained. When Ultimate Skill: Metal Mode is used, each stack of [Invention] present before being cleared will increase {{nickname}}’s overall damage by an additional +30% per stack for the duration of the Ultimate.

Rapidly consuming all Dash Skills will automatically give {{nickname}} the effect [Gamer] and [Tinkering]. These effects are considered effects from a Technical Skill. Whenever either of these effects end, {{nickname}}’s Special Skill cooldowns will reset and {{subject}} gains 2 stacks of [Invention]. {{Subject}} gains twice as many stacks of [Let’m Cook].
{{effect:gamer}}
{{effect:tinkering}}

B1.name: Water Manipulation
B1.description: {{nickname}} utilizes water around and within {{reflexive}}, dealing [Water] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Spray water from {{possessive}} fists, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Throws a sphere of water at opponents, dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slashes with a surging wave, dealing % of attack as damage. Gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana].

additional.text: {{effect:overwhelming-mana}}

S1.name: Bubble Barrier
S1.description: Form a large bubble barrier around {{nickname}} that protects {{reflexive}} and party members. The bubble appears for 10 seconds, and allies who stand within it will take no damage from opponents and heal for % of {{nickname}}’s health per second; however, they cannot damage opponents though Special Skill activation or Basic Skills (activated damage over time and off-field attacks that triggered before entry still function without interruption).

additional.text: If {{nickname}} is outside of the active barrier, increase {{possessive}} damage by +% during the barrier’s duration and passively heal the rest of the party by +% of {{possessive}} health per half-second.
After the barrier dissipates, gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana].
{{effect:overwhelming-mana}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Mana Cost: 120 MP

S2.name: Water Ball
S2.description: {{nickname}} forms a giant vortex of water, forming into a sphere, that {{subject}} launches towards {{possessive}} enemies, dealing [Water] damage.

additional.text: The water ball implodes on opponents and deals % of attack as small AoE damage.
Cooldown: 3 seconds
Mana Cost: 25 MP

S3.name: True Water Spirit Release
S3.description: {{nickname}} creates a spiritual field in which {{possessive}} attacks are enhanced, lasting 15 seconds. {{Subject}} will periodically produce "Spirit Song" stacks, up to 10, once per second (indicated in a special meter next to {{possessive}}). Each stack of [Overwhelming Mana] gained while in the field also gives a stack of "Spirit Song."

additional.text: Per stack produced, {{possessive}} field grows and the strength of {{possessive}} Special Skill damage is increased by +% per stack. At a max of 10 stacks, the next Special Skill damage dealt will increase damage by an additional +%, then removes all stacks.

The field will undergo an elemental change based on the absorbed elements from Technical Skill: A Fox’s Tale, where the active character gains +70% resistance to that element and [Water] element while in the field.
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Mana Cost: 160 MP

U1.name: Transformation
U1.description: Sprays a wide area of water on the field that slows the advance of opponents and aides with allies' movement, lasting 12 seconds. Opponents in the water get the debuff [Slowness] and allies and self get [Speed Up]. {{nickname}}’s movement speed will additionally increase by +% for each stack of [Overwhelming Mana] owned while on the field.

additional.text: {{nickname}} gains an aquatic state which will make {{possessive}} immune to non-elemental, [Fire], and [Wind] attacks, lasting the duration of the field effect. {{Possessive}} water attacks will absorb any incoming attack’s element, changing color, and return it as the same elemental attack in addition to {{possessive}} own. Multiple elements can be mixed and returned.
{{effect:slowness}}
{{effect:speed-up}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: A Fox's Tale
T1.description: {{nickname}}’s Special Skills can absorb incoming elemental attacks of opponents (this does not get rid of the incoming attack), converting to a different color.

additional.text: The absorbed elements will increase that element’s damage for allies and self by +20% for 10 seconds. Opponents hit by the water ball will have their resistance to absorbed elements be reduced by -20% for 10 seconds.
[Water] damage will increase automatically as that is {{nickname}}’s innate magical affinity.
These effects additionally increase by +1% per stack of [Overwhelming Mana]. Gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana] when mixing at least two other elements at once (Cooldown: 3 seconds).
Resonance: No additional effects. Exclusive to {{nickname}}.

T2.name: Infinity Beans
T2.description: Collect the limited time beans progressively through the featured season events.

additional.text: <u>Ability</u>: Uncovers a bag of beans, getting an effect per bean eaten. There is a limit of one bean effect at a time with a cooldown limit interval of eating. Hold skill to alternate between the following:
{{effect:rouge}}
{{effect:jaune}}
{{effect:vert}}
{{effect:bleu}}
{{effect:violet}}
{{effect:blanc}}
{{effect:noir}}

If {{nickname}} is the active character, {{subject}} only has a 1 second cooldown per bean consumption. When {{subject}} gains all bean effects, {{subject}} will switch to an alternate outfit donning a hero’s mark. In this state, all the radiant beans circle around the active character for the remainder of the battle. {{nickname}}’s water attacks from Basic Skill and Special Skills will be infused with the mixed element affinities of the entire party, inflicting their auras on opponents, and triggers element conditions from {{possessive}} other skills if equipped. {{Subject}} gains the effect [Infinity Beans].
{{effect:infinity-beans}}
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Cooldown: 1 second if {{nickname}} is active character
Condition: Adds +5 seconds to Special Skills and putting them in cooldown

Resonance: Other Mystical Legends allies can also use the direct buffs of the Technical Skill. {{nickname:c10}} may also gain the 1 second bean consumption cooldown and the effect [Infinity Beans] after consumption of all the beans.

Dupes.description: Can obtain infinite stacks of [Overwhelming Mana] and each stack gained will heal self and allies for 5% of {{possessive}} max health. For every 5 stacks, increase crit rate and damage for self and allies by +5% but increase mana consumption by +5%. When 50 stacks are gained, increase self’s damage of all skills by +50%.

additional.text: Gain a stack of [Overwhelming Mana] every 5 seconds (Unconditional). All effect conditions that depend on gaining a stack will trigger automatically when obtaining these passive stacks.

Using the Dash Skill will enable {{object}} to enter into a water transformed state called Aquia Mode, negating damage completely and moving quickly, creating a water trail behind {{object}}. Stamina will be continuously consumed. {{Subject}} will take +50% more damage from an attack with [Knockback], ending the state.
{{effect:overwhelming-mana}}
{{effect:knockback}}
When max MP to less than 5%, gain the effect [Mana Recovery].
{{effect:mana-recovery}}

When obtaining [Overwhelming Mana], gain two instances instead of one. Gaining a stack increases {{possessive}} and allies’ MP regen by +1%, up to +50%. Effect scales proportionally to the number of stacks {{subject}} has and is infinite so long as {{subject}} has a stack.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

{{nickname}}’s Special Skill cooldowns are permanently decreased by 3 seconds. The Special Skill: Water Ball consumes a single instance of [Overwhelming Mana] which increases the size of the AoE to a larger field range and self gains +10% damage increase. The rate continues to increase incrementally when the skill is used repeatedly in short succession and resets when ending repeated skill use and having mana depleted.

[Overwhelming Mana] gain enhances even further, up to three stacks are gained instead of one. Each stack will increase {{nickname}}’s Basic Skill damage by +2%. Whenever one is consumed, heal 2% of max health and recover 17 MP for self and all allies.

B1.name: Compression Water Discharge
B1.description: {{nickname}} enforces {{possessive}} authority by bending the water around {{object}}, dealing [Water] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Water compresses into droplets and are hurled towards opponents, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: A spiral of water that pinpoints on nearby opponents and strangles them, dealing % of defense as damage and inflicting the [Slowness] effect.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slams an orb of water on the ground in front, dealing % of defense as small AoE damage and inflicting [Dazed].

additional.text: {{effect:slowness}}
{{effect:dazed}}

S1.name: Reflection Counter
S1.description: {{nickname}} counters incoming attacks by raising a compressed water wall, dealing the damage that an incoming attack would deal back at the opponents as [Water] damage. This wall will remain even when {{nickname}} is off-field and stays for seconds. AoE attacks will not be completely deflected.

additional.text: The repelled attack can crit, in fact, the crit chance and damage increases by +% for every 100 MP depleted from max MP overall (not just from this skill).
Whoever the shield is not repelling an attack, every second, a refund of MP will be given to {{nickname}} equal to .
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 200 MP

S2.name: Counterstrike(+)
S2.description: Throw quick, rapid magically imbued fist and compressed water projectile strikes, dealing % of defense as [Water] damage per strike, up to 15 strikes when this skill button is held down.

additional.text: When this skill ends, {{nickname}}’ Basic Skill is greatly enhanced by an aura of blue mana, increasing {{possessive}} attack speed by +50% and initial damage increase of +%, consuming 15 MP per second and increasing damage increase by +% per second also. The enhancement ends when no MP remains or when another Special Skill is used (not including this Special Skill).
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Mana Cost: 80 MP

U1.name: Sage Cloud Surfer
U1.description: {{nickname}} forms a transfiguration circle called Elevator of Heaven and summons a floating sage circle where {{subject}} stands superior to {{possessive}} opponents until {{possessive}} mana is completely drained or when this skill button is pressed again.

additional.text: Whilst standing high, {{subject}} gains +75% dodge chance and 100% increased movement speed. {{Subject}} loses -3% of max MP per second.
All attacks from skills {{subject}} uses become ranged attacks that ignore 40% of the opponent’s defense.
When this mode ends, either through mana depletion or Ultimate Skill press, {{nickname}} slams down onto the ground, sending a wave in all directions, dealing % of defense as [Water] AoE damage.
If MP is less than 10% when this skill activates, instead, restore % of max MP back and gain the effect [Magic Amplification].
{{effect:magic-amplification}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Tempest Aquia
T1.description: Ability: Plants a banner on the ground equal to 200% of defense which boosts all Tempest Aquia cohort members until it is destroyed.

additional.text: > +15% damage increase for each same cohort member in the party (max 3 stacks).
> Gain the [Resistance] effect.
> Accumulate [Shield] effect equal to 0.3% of {{nickname}}’ defense every second.
When this skill is used again, if the banner still remains, sacrifice it to gain +150 MP per second for {{nickname}} for 10 seconds. This activation ability does not cost energy.
{{effect:resistance}}
{{effect:shield}}
Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: Every time a Special Skill is used, recover 150 stamina points, and every time the Dash Skill is used, instantly recovers 50 MP.

additional.text: {{nickname}} gains +3% piercing for each percentage of damage increase from {{possessive}} skills or any buffs (any mentioned elemental damage increase does not apply towards the count).
Incoming attacks are converted into [Shield] equivalent to 25% of defense plus 10% of the incoming attack's damage value before the attack’s damage takes effect.

When {{nickname}} dashes, {{possessive}} interruption resistance is increased and {{subject}} will deal 40% of {{possessive}} defense as damage to nearby opponents as short range [Water] projectile needles that automatically hones in on them. Summons 3 at a time. A trail of water is left behind {{object}}.
{{effect:shield}}
The Basic Skill permanently becomes +20% faster. Adds a fourth stage to the Basic Skill of the following:

Stage 4: Form a vortex of water to swish opponents vigorously, dealing 130% of defense as AoE [Water] damage and restoring 40 MP per opponent hit. Increase damage by an additional +40% for opponents inflicted with a debuff. The damage increases by +10% for each level of the equipped Basic Skill, not counted as damage increase.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%. This is considered a damage increase and will count for the piercing bonus.

When {{nickname}}’ MP reaches below 15 points, automatically activate Special Skill: Reflection Counter even if it is not equipped. The skill will mimic the same level as the level of the owned skill itself.
When dashing, restore +30 more MP and summon an additional 6 water projectile needles. The needles become denser and will penetrate through multiple opponents before shattering.

Using two Special Skills in a brief moment will instantly charge the energy gauge by +20% and consume 130 MP. Also, the first Special Skill turns into Ultimate Skill: Black Hole Water Detonation which can be activated at any time if sufficient energy gauge is present.

Ultimate Skill: Black Hole Water Detonation - {{nickname}} creates a vortex of compressed energy that sucks mana particles and then collapses in a wide AoE, dealing 450% of defense as [Water] damage and makes own buffs and debuffs applied stay for twice as long as its current duration remaining. Requires having 35% of energy gauge to activate. The skill’s damage increases by +10% per level of equipped Ultimate Skill, not counted as normal damage increase.

B1.name: Sword Play
B1.description: {{nickname}} shows the sheer skill of the greatest swordsman to exist, dealing normal damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Slash in several quick arcs in front, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Lunges as a piercing thrust, increasing piercing by +% for this stage and dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Create an illusion of two swords striking on either side, each dealing % of attack as damage and applying [Dazed] on hit opponents. The duration of effect extends by 3 seconds when dealing elemental damage. Each level of this Basic Skill will increase the duration by an additional 1 second(s).

additional.text: {{effect:dazed}}

S1.name: Fire Increaser
S1.description: {{nickname}} takes {{possessive}} customized Fire Increaser and releases the built-up chemicals as fire, dealing AoE [Fire] damage equal to % of attack.

additional.text: This attack can be used by paying stamina when {{nickname}} has no base MP.
When the [Inferno] effect is active, AoE damage becomes massive and deals +100% more damage.
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Mana Cost: 133 MP
Stamina Cost: 50 p

S2.name: Meteor Shower
S2.description: Light the sky with sparkling fire lights, showering down upon the battlefield in a large randomized AoE, dealing massive [Normal] and [Fire] AoE damage equal to % of attack per hit.

additional.text: When holding skill, consume a portion of mana to deal the same damage but shoot a single fireball as ranged damage.

After gaining [Inferno] for the first time, instead, {{nickname}} will sacrifice all of {{possessive}} health, reducing to 1 health and gaining [Indestructible], and change Ultimate Skill slot to Ultimate Skill: Hellflame Meteor which has a single use.

Ultimate Skill: Hellflame Meteor - Mustering mana, a ginormous meteor of gigantic proportions is summed and hurled towards the field directly before {{nickname}}, dealing % of attack as [Fire] large AoE damage plus the value of [Shield] on self added to base damage. This Skill requires a filled meter of “Fighting Spirit” to additionally activate. Every hit from attacks by the team (on-field or off-field) contributes to filling the meter.
{{effect:indestructible}}
Cooldown: 13 seconds
Mana Cost: 170 MP
Hold Mana Cost: 40 MP per fireball
Ultimate Skill Energy Gauge: 100%
Ultimate Skill Fighting Spirit: 50 points

U1.name: Limitless Nova Beam
U1.description: Stand there in intimidation, almost burning the atmosphere, dealing [Fire] damage equal to % of attack in a small AoE in front.

additional.text: When the [Inferno] effect is active, launch a condensed inferno fire beam from the chest to opponents, increasing AoE, dealing +% additional damage. The attack lingers for 3 seconds and deals damage in intervals of 1 second. Deals damage in 0.5 second intervals if against a single opponent.
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Flame Reincarnation
T1.description: <u>Ability</u>: Even weaknesses can be overcome by sheer unwavering will. {{nickname}} reduces the opponent’s attack potency.

additional.text: {{nickname}} slashes with a deadly blow, dealing normal damage equal to 330% of attack that ignores all of the opponent's defense, inflicting [Weakened]. The damage increases by the value of [Shield] on {{nickname}}, added to base damage. Skill’s damage will increase by +10% for each level of equipped Basic Skill.
A certain power lies dormant.
{{effect:weakened}}
Energy Gauge: 30%
Resonance: Any character can utilize this ability but the damage stays as normal damage and the additional damage increase is still based on the character’s [Shield].

Dupes.description: When health reaches below 30%, permanently gain the [Inferno] effect which cannot be removed and a [Shield] equal to 33% of defense stat.

additional.text: {{nickname:c6}} gains +3% piercing for each percentage of damage increase from {{possessive:c6}} skills or any buffs (any mentioned elemental damage increase does not apply towards the count).
{{effect:inferno}}
{{effect:burn}}
{{effect:shield}}

When using the Dash Skill during the [Inferno] state, additionally leave a wide trail of flames behind distance traveled, lasting the duration of the battle, that will deal continuous [Fire] damage equal to 100% of self’s attack per second (can crit) and decrease opponent movement speed by -25%.

After obtaining base MP stat from the [Inferno] effect, regain 3 MP for each successful Basic Skill stage hit. The trail of flames from dashing will now be considered Basic Skill damage and become larger.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
The Technical Skill: Flame Reincarnation will automatically bring {{nickname}}’ health down to 30% and activate the [Inferno] and [Bandage] effects.
{{effect:bandage}}
The [Burn] effect will be enhanced to [Burn II]. It cannot be removed using regular debuff clearing effects. Skills deal +130% more damage on opponents with the debuff [Electrocute].
{{effect:burn2}}
{{effect:electrocute}}
{{effect:freeze}}

B1.name: Dancing Purple Flame
B1.description: {{nickname}} lights {{possessive}} hands with bright flames, dealing [Fire] damage and inflicting [Life Drain] every other hit.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Blows fluttering butterfly flames at opponents, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Tosses sparkling flames that explode, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: A fiery flower descends and crushes enemies, dealing % of attack as empowered damage.

additional.text: {{effect:life-drain}}

S1.name: Hellflame Purgatory Prison
S1.description: A small flaming cage appears and traps enemies in front in a small radius, clumping them and nearby opponents together and making it more difficult for escape, dealing % of attack as [Fire] damage per second for 8 seconds.

additional.text: Applies 2 stacks of the [Life Drain] effect on each trapped opponent upon the first instance of damage.

The attack can be active while {{subject}} is off-field and will deal the same damage per second to opponents that touch the cage. There is then a % chance for the [Life Drain] effect to apply per hit (amount above 100% counts chance for extra stacks).
{{effect:life-drain}}
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Mana Cost: 170 MP

S2.name: Magic Absorption
S2.description: {{nickname}} summons a spiral of flames in front of {{object}} that sucks incoming attacks and converts them into mana proportional to the mana cost of that attack. For every attack sucked, % of the mana cost of the attack becomes {{possessive}} own. The field effect will last for 4 seconds starting.

additional.text: Opponents hit in the vortex also get a single instance of the effects [Mana Drain] and [Life Drain].
{{effect:mana-drain}}
{{effect:life-drain}}
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 110 MP

U1.name: Flame Dragon’s Ascent - True Coming
U1.description: Summon a flaming dragon to descend from the skies to burn opponents in a wide line in front, dealing % of attack as [Fire] AoE super empowered damage.

additional.text: The damage increases by +% for each percentage of MP opponents are missing from their max cap.

<u>Auxiliary Passive</u>: Energy gauge will fill by +2.5% for every 1% MP gained from opponents (based on opponents’ percentage drained from their max). Each instance of natural MP regen and external restoration will fill the energy gauge by +1%. This effect is active indefinitely during the battle.
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Blue Legion
T1.description: Ability: Activate and use a random Special Skill of a fellow ally Blue Legion cohort member. The used skill does not cost any mana nor activates the owner’s skill cooldown. The skill keeps its original affinities and effects.

additional.text: Energy Gauge: 25%

The other members of the cohort in party will have all their Special, Basic, and Ultimate Skill levels increased by +1 from current level (can exceed max level cap). Each time they use a Special or Ultimate Skill, {{nickname}}’s skills’ field duration increases by +50% from original duration (stacking infinitely).
Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: When opponents with [Life Drain] effect attack {{nickname}}, their attack stat is decreased by the percentage value missing from their max health, up to 99.9% attack reduction.

additional.text: When skills inflict damage on opponents with [Life Drain] effect, {{nickname}}’s skills does [Dark] element damage in addition, adding its aura as well. Excess gained health from the effect will be evenly distributed among allies as a healing effect.
Every Basic Skill hit on opponents will consume 0.3% of {{nickname}}’s health but will increase Basic Skill damage by +15%, only when above 50% max health.
Restore 5 MP per 0.5% of health taken from [Life Drain] (stackable from multiple targets).
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
So long as MP is at max, crit damage increases by +200% for self.
MP gain from all sources increases by +100%, including Mana Regen, for self.

If {{subject}} would gain mana that goes above max MP, give the extra to allies split equally. If allies have max MP, store the extra MP as a surplus that increases [Fire] elemental damage for the team by each percentage of MP above {{possessive}} max MP.

A special purple meter covers part of each character’s MP bar to display active stored percentage. A number above will indicate the elemental damage increase accumulated. The active character that consumes the most MP from the bar while it is active will be prioritized and the elemental damage increase will be converted to the element damage dealt in their skills.
For another character to take priority, they must also instead consume the most MP to convert the elemental damage increase. A new instance of the meter will reset state and priorities.

B1.name: Flash Rejuvenate
B1.description: {{nickname}} slices the air to create lightning that {{subject}} controls, its diverse intensity able to harm and heal, having [Wind] element.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Claps lightning between {{possessive}} hands and heals the ally with the lowest health by % of {{possessive}} own max health. Attacks opponents in the blast for that amount of health amount as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Clutch a lightning orb and release it forward rapidly, becoming able to absorb and reflect a single incoming attack for its duration. This can also work with AoE attacks.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Directs a surge of lightning around {{object}} that inflicts [Knockback], damaging and converting x random debuff on self or allies into an applicable buff. Hit opponents are dealt damage equal to % of {{possessive}} health. Skill upgrades can increase the debuff conversion number by a percentage, acting as a percentage rate.

additional.text: <u>Applicable Buff</u>: Any debuff that reduces a certain stat or modifier (element resistance) will be converted to their reciprocal at the same value and duration. Drain debuffs remain the same but also reversed in effect.
{{effect:knockback}}

S1.name: One-Tap Megavolt
S1.description: Become still and summon a sphere of electricity that has a stability meter which records the amount of absorbed elemental attacks from opponents. Can take a bulk amount before being destroyed. Opponents nearby will take [Knockback]. Most enemies will prioritize attacking the sphere with elemental attacks.

additional.text: When the electric sphere is on-field, this skill button can be spammed to raise its charge meter. When the charge meter is filled, the electric sphere will implode and send a shockwave that reduces self, allies, and all opponents’ health within a medium range, dealing 2 instances of [Wind] super empowered damage.

The amount of damage per target per hit is equal to % of {{nickname}}’s max health, being able to reduce at max 90% of a target character’s health. The damage is tripled on bosses. After 4 seconds, if any character has buffs, they immediately recover their lost health.
{{effect:knockback}}
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Mana Cost: 180 MP
Energy Gauge: 20% to detonate

S2.name: Electrostatic Engage
S2.description: A wave of electricity is expanded outward around {{nickname}}, inflicting the [Freeze] debuff on opponents in range. The wave inflicts an effect that transfers buffs from them to self. The amount of buffs is dependent on their debuff resistance. Up to x of 5 buffs can be transferred (above 100% increases the number of buffs even more).

additional.text: The buffs transferred go in a time-frozen state in which they do not activate nor tick down their duration. Stolen [Shield] and the related will take effect and will not be time-frozen. Each buff gained on self will heal self and allies by % of {{possessive}} max health.
{{effect:freeze}}
{{effect:shield}}
Cooldown: 11 seconds per charge
Mana Cost: 250 MP

U1.name: Electrostasis Pulse
U1.description: {{nickname:c10}} gathers lightning into {{possessive:c10}} palm and lets it free to implode the space around {{object:c10}}.

additional.text: The lightning will send a high current in a wide AoE, dealing % of attack as [Wind] damage.
If {{subject}} has an active power meter, consumes 9 points and the AoE is increased further and, upon use, gains 30% of energy gauge back.
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Black Rampart
T1.description: When {{nickname}} heals and the entire team is at max health, fill a health meter with the excess health points. All Black Rampart members that have [Surge] will have every stat scaled and increased by +0.005% for each point of additional health in the health meter. Excess health will be depleted before regular health when taking damage and is shared between all characters in the party. The health meter stays indefinitely.

additional.text: Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: {{nickname:c10}}’s movement speed is inversely related to {{possessive:c10}} health where every 1% of health missing from max will increase {{possessive:c10}} movement speed by +1%. Skill damage will increase by each percentage of crit rate over 100% at a 1-to-1 rate. Whenever {{nickname:c10}} damages an opponent with an uninfused skill, {{subject:c10}} applies [Claw Mark] effect on them.

additional.text: {{effect:claw-mark}}
When the party consists only of [Wind] and [Water] elements, the opponent’s resistance to those elements are reduced by -25% within battle proximity.
Every 200 points of attack stat {{nickname:c10}} has will increase {{possessive:c10}} crit rate by +1%. {{Possessive:c10}} piercing stat increases by +1% for every 5% of crit rate.

The power meter from Special Skill: Lightning God Mode will start with 150 points. Each point missing from the meter when a Basic Skill is used will increase damage by +1%. {{Possessive}} attack speed increases by +0.2% per point on the meter.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
Opponent’s resistance to [Wind] and [Water] elements are further reduced by an additional -25% for the party consisting of only those affinities.

Extra Life: When {{nickname:c10}} would be defeated by a lethal attack, {{subject:c10}} gains immunity and restores 9% of {{possessive:c10}} health. {{Subject:c10}} additionally gains the effect [Invincibility]. This effect occurs only once per battle.
{{effect:invincibility}}
Increase [Lightning Element] damage for self and allies by +40%.

The Technical Skill: Lightning Discharge is improved: Having [Lightning Element] aura and next damaged by [Water] attacks will increase the instance of hits by +1 for each party member of the inflictor with an element aura on themselves on the battlefield (each element and person is counted once). Having [Water] aura and being hit by [Lightning Element] attack will increase instances based on {{nickname:c10}}’s power meter where every 10 points missing increases the hit instance by +1.

B1.name: Feline Fury
B1.description: {{nickname}} swipes attacks in close range, {{possessive}} quick swoops dealing normal damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Swipes two lightning claws forward, dealing % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Pounces upwards and crashes down, dealing small AoE damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Spins quickly with cat claws outstretched, clobbering opponents, ensnaring them in place, and dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack.

additional.text: Hold skill before a stage to pounce on the target opponent, dealing the Stage’s damage.

S1.name: Lightning God Mode
S1.description: {{nickname}} infuses {{possessive}} basic attacks with yellow lightning that stuns all who come in close vicinity. {{Subject}} gains a power meter with 100 points which remains until all points are consumed.

additional.text: {{Possessive}} Basic Skill is infused with [Wind] damage, {{possessive}} attack speed increasing by +%. Each stage of {{possessive}} Basic Skill used will deplete 2 points and the cost increases by +2 points per stage increment, but resetting when Stage 1 is used again.
Every 15 points depleted will send an AoE [Wind] shockwave equal to % of the value of the last damage dealt (after crits) and inflicting [Electrocute].
{{effect:electrocute}}
Cooldown: 18 seconds
Mana Cost: 130 MP

S2.name: Lynx Prowl
S2.description: {{nickname}} quickens {{possessive}} pace so {{subject}} strikes before any refute. This skill has 9 charges which can be used anytime.

additional.text: A charge consumed will enable {{nickname}}’s Golden Flash state for 9 seconds if {{subject}} has it inactive. Each charge used (including first) will increase {{possessive}} movement speed by +20% and all damage from Skills by +% during the state, stackable. Each stage of {{possessive}} Basic Skill unleashed will phase {{possessive}} forward rapidly before dealing the Basic Skill stage’s damage.
Whenever a charge is consumed, {{nickname}}’s health will decrease by -8% and {{possessive}} defense will decrease by -5% for the duration of {{possessive}} Golden Flash state, stacking per charge.
Cooldown: 4 seconds per charge
Mana Cost: 15 MP

U1.name: Electrostasis Pulse
U1.description: {{nickname}} gathers lightning into {{possessive}} palm and lets it free to implode the space around {{object}}.

additional.text: The lightning will send a high current in a wide AoE, dealing % of attack as [Wind] damage.
If {{subject}} has an active power meter, consumes 9 points and the AoE is increased further and, upon use, gains 30% of energy gauge back.
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Lightning Discharge
T1.description: Allies and self with lightning based attacks (stated in skill descriptions, but usually without special effects) will have their respective elements converted to [Lightning Element] damage (applies to all skills that deal elemental damage). Each character whose element is converted will still inherently keep the former’s elements’ buffs, resistances and auras.

additional.text: [Lightning Element]: A special elemental attack which shreds barriers, reducing hit opponent’s defense by -25% when lightning attack lands. The lightning attack will also apply a [Charged] counter on opponents which stack up to 5 times. This element can maintain its lightning element aura for a short time on inflicted opponents.
When this element interacts with water in the environment, it creates a reactive explosion that launches self, allies, and foes a great deal in velocity direction.
{{effect:charged}}
Resonance: No additional effects. Condition remains the same for lightning-based attack requirements.

T2.name: Contamination
T2.description: One of the Eight Forces, now wielded by {{nickname}} {{reflexive}}. If {{nickname}} has unlocked up to 2 unique Special Skills that infuse {{possessive}} Basic Skill with two unique elements, then any Special Skill that has infusion will apply both elements simultaneously to Basic Skill, allowing simultaneous aura application. Only one of these Special Skills need to be equipped.

additional.text: Resonance: No additional effects. Condition remains the same for lightning-based attack requirements.

Dupes.description: {{nickname}}’s movement speed is inversely related to {{possessive}} health, where every 1% of health missing from max will increase {{possessive}} movement speed by +1%. Skill damage will increase by each percentage point of crit rate over 100% at a 1-to-1 rate. Whenever {{nickname}} damages an opponent with an uninfused skill, {{subject}} applies [Claw Mark] effect on them.

additional.text: {{effect:claw-mark}}
When the party consists only of [Wind] and [Water] elements, the opponent’s resistance to those elements is reduced by -25% within battle proximity.
Every 200 points of attack stat {{nickname}} has will increase {{possessive}} crit rate by +1%. {{Possessive}} piercing stat increases by +1% for every 5% of crit rate.

The power meter from Special Skill: Lightning God Mode will start with 150 points. Each point missing from the meter when a Basic Skill is used will increase damage by +1%. {{Possessive}} attack speed increases by +0.2% per point on the meter.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
Opponent’s resistance to [Wind] and [Water] elements is further reduced by an additional -25% for the party consisting solely of those affinities.

Extra Life: When {{nickname}} is defeated by a lethal attack, {{subject}} gains immunity and restores 9% of {{possessive}} health. {{Subject}} additionally gains the effect [Invincibility]. This effect occurs only once per battle.
{{effect:invincibility}}
Increase [Lightning Element] damage for self and allies by +40%.

The Technical Skill: Lightning Discharge is improved: Having a [Lightning Element] aura and being damaged by [Water] attacks will increase the number of hits by +1 for each party member of the inflictor with an element aura on themselves on the battlefield (each element and person is counted once). Having a [Water] aura and being hit by a [Lightning Element] attack will increase instances based on {{nickname}}’s power meter; for every 10 points missing, the hit instance increases by +1.

B1-1.name: Fighting For His Boss (Earth Discharge)
B1-1.description: {{nickname}} unleashes {{possessive}} hammer of rock and pounds around, dealing [Earth] damage and [Knockback].

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Smash in front, dealing AoE empowered damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Swing hammer in an arc in front, dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Smash around three times, forming large craters, dealing AoE empowered damage equal to % of attack. Opponents touching craters get the debuff [Dazed].

additional.text: {{effect:dazed}}
{{effect:knockback}}

B1-2.name: Lightning Rondo (Electricity Discharge)
B1-2.description: {{nickname}} coats {{possessive}} body in lightning and charges forward, dealing [Fire] damage and applying [Electrocute] per hit.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Shoot small bolts ahead, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Throw a condensed whip of lightning, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Charged Basic Skill: Costing -5% of energy gauge, charge up an ultra-sized ball of lightning, taking 3 seconds, increasing movement speed by +150% during its charge. When charged, it will be tossed forward, dealing AoE ranged damage equal to % of attack. This stage will be skipped if the energy gauge is empty.

additional.text: Can activate Stage 3 by holding Basic Skill.
{{effect:electrocute}}
{{effect:freeze}}

B1-3.name: Tornado Engulfment (Wind Discharge)
B1-3.description: {{nickname}} conjures wind around {{object}} that bends to {{possessive}} will, dealing [Wind] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Wields a wind blade and swipes quickly, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Send a gust of wind that bewilders opponents, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Costing -3% of energy gauge, summons a mini-tornado in front, dealing % of attack as damage. The tornado will linger for 5 seconds and absorb the next attack (from self or ally) and buff its damage by +20% ([Fire] getting +40% instead). This stage will be skipped if the energy gauge is empty.

additional.text: Every stage hit will heal self and allies for 30% of the damage dealt.

S1-1.name: Mound Defense
S1-1.description: {{nickname}} becomes fired up (only temporarily as {{subject}} is lazy often, but chooses to act for {{possessive}} boss). {{Subject}} grants a [Shield] to allies and self equal to % of max health if any ally has their health at or below 30%.

additional.text: {{effect:shield}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Mana Cost: 170 MP

S1-2.name: Mana Zone - Eletrostep Overdrive
S1-2.description: Gathering the surrounding mana, {{nickname}} will gain an enhanced electricity state that will increase {{possessive}} Basic Skill damage by % for 15 seconds. {{Possessive}} steps become a blur of lightning, increasing movement speed by an additional +1% for each extra point of movement speed above 100.

additional.text: In the state, {{possessive}} interruption resistance will increase and {{subject}} can pass through opponents, inflicting [Electrocute].
{{effect:electrocute}}
{{effect:freeze}}
Cooldown: 18 seconds
Mana Cost: 230 MP

S1-3.name: Towering Tornado
S1-3.description: Summon a larger swirling tornado for 5 seconds that gathers opponents together, a range of 20 meters, and flattens them, dealing % of attack as [Wind] damage.

additional.text: Each opponent gathered will struggle, unable to escape easily for the tornado’s duration, and heal self and allies for % of max health for each opponent gathered.
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 155 MP

S2.name: Prepare to Fight!
S2.description: Gather elemental power together and create a ring around self with the respective active subordinate’s element, absorbing % of incoming damage, an additional +10% for projectiles, for 10 seconds.

additional.text: Active character will continuously gain the effect [Hyped] while elemental ring is active.
[Hyped] Buff: Basic Skill will only perform Stage 3 when attacking, skipping prior stages, lasting 5 seconds.
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Mana Cost: 90 MP

U1.name: A Kick, a Punch, and… Serious
U1.description: If the character’s health is above 40%, perform the skill as titled, otherwise, when below, transform to Ultimate Skill: Mountain Truck Rampage.

additional.text: <u>Ultimate Skill: A Kick, a Punch, and…</u> - The current subordinate proves their worth to their boss with exclusive talent. Throw a series of fast close-quarters punches via the Basic Skill, imbued with the damage and element of the subordinate’s Stage 3. The state lasts for 15 seconds and will add a rage to the tri-node rage meter per hit, dispersing a shockwave and resistance shred at its prescribed intervals.

Ultimate Skill: Mountain Truck Rampage - The other two subordinates arrive on the scene and the trio will hop into the newly summoned vehicle, a truck. The vehicle can be controlled and will deal active member’s elemental damage equal to % of attack when ramming any number of enemies. The vehicle gains +20% of speed stat and lasts for 13 seconds.

During the duration, gain 15 combat rage points and other subordinates will perform their Stage 3 Basic Skill attacks per stack, depleting a stack per attack. If {{nickname:c7}} is an ally, {{subject:c7}} will also join the ride and attack with {{possessive:c7}} Stage 3 Basic Skill, consuming a stack. All who can attack will attack every 2 seconds.
For self and {{nickname:c7}}, heal +% of health per second on the ride’s duration.
Energy Gauge: 130% (Requires overflow energy as indicated by a secondary gauge on the Ultimate Skill button)

T1.name: Attack Unison - All for One!
T1.description: When stamina is reduced to less than 5%, rotate to the next subordinate in the order: {{nickname:c11:0}}, {{nickname:c11:2}}, {{nickname:c11:1}} (Cooldown: 20 seconds). Restore 30% stamina upon switching.

additional.text: When switching, the next character will come in and deal 350% of attack as their respective elemental damage and apply a -15% resistance reduction to that element to hit opponents for 25 seconds.

A special tri-node rage meter will record the instance of each rotation. At three points, a shockwave will hit nearby opponents for the same damage and an additional elemental resistance reduction of -25% will be applied to those that have one for a new duration of 40 seconds (costs -15% of energy gauge to apply).
The damage each subordinate deals upon entry and the damage of the shockwave is further amplified by +10% per level of the highest Special Skill equipped.
Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: {{nickname:c11:0}} will receive a defense bonus of +30%, {{nickname:c11:2}} gains +50% piercing, and {{nickname:c11:1}} receives +20% attack speed and movement speed. The subordinates’ energy gauge accumulation is -20% less effective as other characters but they can gain a max of 200% of energy instead of 100%.

additional.text: A main individual can be chosen out of the trio to be the first summoned when in a party selection.

Obtain a combat rage meter that stores the number of successive Basic Skill stage hits (max 25), deteriorating one stack per 2 seconds when reaching 10 stacks. While rage meter is active, it will cause the other two subordinates not active to attack with their respective Stage 1 Basic Skills randomly every 3 seconds. This can occur even when the active subordinate is off-field.
When the other subordinates attack from the cumulative rage meter, inflict the [Debuff Contagion] effect on opponents. Increases energy gauge gain by +2% for every stack in the rage meter.
[Debuff Contagion] Debuff: Opponents’ resistance to debuffs are decreased by -50% for 9 seconds.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

Status effects that deal damage over time, like [Burn] or [Poison], will deal more damage to enemies with resistance reduction of any element, the damage scaling increases as a percentage equal to the highest percentage of resistance reduction on the opponent. Such applied debuff effects will have a duration increase of +30%.

The combat rage meter can accumulate stacks while the subordinates are off-field when the current active character attacks with Basic Skill hits. All three subordinates will then attack with Stage 2 Basic Skill attacks randomly every 3 seconds. The damage will increase by +30% when the subordinates are off-field for more than 5 seconds and effect will end when they come back on-field.

B1.name: Compression Water Discharge
B1.description: {{nickname}} enforces {{possessive}} authority by bending the water around {{object}}, dealing [Water] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Water compresses into droplets and are hurled towards opponents, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: A spiral of water that pinpoints on nearby opponents and strangles them, dealing % of defense as damage and inflicting the [Slowness] effect.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slams an orb of water on the ground in front, dealing % of defense as small AoE damage and inflicting [Dazed].

additional.text: {{effect:slowness}}
{{effect:dazed}}

tree-n001.name: The Heart
tree-n001.description: The beginning of one’s journey. Progress and gain new skills.

additional.text: Follow the course best desirable of your playstyle. Each node may begin focused or coverage broadly, allowing for pre-planning for the best course. Advance and collect Skill Points, converted from SR or SSR Star Level Fragments or story progression, to spend on unlocking additional nodes. Upon reaching a high enough node level, you will begin to step into the other previously unreachable nodes to combine multiple abilities, roles, or stats together.
Join a cohort at Regnum Academy for additional synergy with other characters. Attain affiliations by exploring the world and increase synergy with even more allies.

tree-n002.name: Path of the Mystical
tree-n002.description: Become a Mystical Being, gaining mana through inherent magical potential. Gain +800 MP as a base stat.

additional.text: Conflicts with Path of the Mainlander.

tree-n003.name: Path of the Mainlander
tree-n003.description: Become a Mainlander, a non-Mystical Being, remaining adamant of the Mystical and relying on one’s mind and physical strengths. Reject the ability to use MP and element attacks, but attack stat increases by +40%.

additional.text: Conflicts with Path of the Mystical.

tree-n004.name: Agent
tree-n004.description: Become a stealthy assassin that bewilders enemies before striking. Increase luck by +40%, gain +5% crit hit rate, and increase movement speed by +30%. Passively gain the consistent effect [Assassin’s Touch].

additional.text: Conflicts with other Roles. Can only choose one main role.
{{effect:assassin-s-touch}}
{{effect:marked}}

tree-n005.name: Defense
tree-n005.description: Absorb attacks of allies and become the very best armor piercer. Increase defense by +50% and gain +15 base piercing as a stat. Whenever the third stage of the Basic Skill is used, gain a single stack of [Flash]. Using any Special Skill will grant a [Shield] equal to 200% of defense to self and allies.

additional.text: Conflicts with other Roles. Can only choose one main role.
{{effect:shield}}
{{effect:flash}}

tree-n006.name: Fighter
tree-n006.description: A warrior by heart who seeks the victory in conquering head on with strength and tactics. Increase attack by +20%, movement speed by +10%, and crit damage by +10%. When using staged basic skills, the first stage hit will apply [Valiant] to self, the second stage will apply [Dazed] on hit opponent, and the third stage will apply [Flash].

additional.text: Conflicts with other Roles. Can only choose one main role.
{{effect:valiant}}
{{effect:dazed}}
{{effect:flash}}

tree-n007.name: Healer
tree-n007.description: Become the lifeline of the party by buffing and healing self and allies. Apply the effect [Rapid Recovery] whenever an ally or self drops below 20% health (Cooldown: 30 seconds). All received [Shield] effects on self will be enhanced to the buff [Ultimate Shield] when health reaches below 50%.

additional.text: Conflicts with other Roles. Can only choose one main role.
When receiving a buff, heal self and the party for 5% of max health. This only occurs once per instance of buff gained with a cooldown of 3 seconds.
{{effect:ultimate-shield}}
{{effect:rapid-recovery}}

tree-n008.name: Water Affinity
tree-n008.description: Gain the water affinity, dealing [Water] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Conflicts with other Element Affinities. Can only choose one affinity.
Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.

tree-n009.name: Earth Affinity
tree-n009.description: Gain the earth affinity, dealing [Earth] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Conflicts with other Element Affinities. Can only choose one affinity.
Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.

tree-n010.name: Fire Affinity
tree-n010.description: Gain the fire affinity, dealing [Fire] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Conflicts with other Element Affinities. Can only choose one affinity.
Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.

tree-n011.name: Wind Affinity
tree-n011.description: Gain the wind affinity, dealing [Wind] elemental damage from all skills.

additional.text: Conflicts with other Element Affinities. Can only choose one affinity.
Unlock the Special Skill: Element Discharge.

tree-n060.name: Specialty: Debuffing
tree-n060.description: When opponents inflict debuffs on the active character, there is a 30% chance it will not apply. When the active character inflicts debuffs on opponents, there is a 30% chance for the debuff to apply guaranteed, regardless of opponent debuff resistance.
